title: French presidential elections 2027: More candidates, more confusion (Episode 2)
summary: France will head to the polls to vote for its next president in the spring of 2027. Thirty-eight candidates are currently vying to make it onto the final ballot and have until March 12 to gather backing from 500 elected officials. One figure currently stands out: Marine Le Pen. The far-right National Rally leader has a significant lead in the latest polls.
